_comment: known_malicious_ips ships empty of real-world entries on purpose. Unlike malicious_ports.json (port numbers are stable, well-known indicators), IP reputation goes stale fast - a flagged IP can be reassigned to an innocent party later, so we don't bundle real-world IOCs here. Populate this file with entries from your own threat-intel feed. The three placeholders below are RFC 5737 TEST-NET documentation addresses (never live on the real internet) so the detector has something to match against out of the box; delete them once you add real entries.

known_malicious_ips.desc: RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1 placeholder - replace with real threat-intel IOCs
